description.value: The Yaletown Keg is a multi-floor steakhouse and bar occupying a corner building in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, steps from BC Place and Rogers Arena. The location spans four floors including a street-front patio and a year-round rooftop patio, which the venue describes as one of the best in Vancouver. It offers private and semi-private dining for large groups, full accessibility via elevator, and delivery exclusively through DoorDash.
